recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆中型淋巴細胞，細胞質少而偏嗜鹼性，核圓至不規則、部分有凹陷，染色質中度凝集並隱約可見核仁；右側一顆細胞核呈腎形凹陷，符合 T 前淋巴球（T-PLL）的形態。
features: Intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, about 1.5 times a red cell diameter
Moderate N:C ratio with a rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Round to irregular nuclei, one with a prominent indentation (reniform)
Moderately condensed chromatin with an indistinct nucleolus in some cells
Subtle irregular cytoplasmic outlines; background red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of basophilic cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei including one with a distinct indentation, moderately condensed chromatin and small, indistinct nucleoli. Red cells are unremarkable. The cells are larger and less mature-appearing than normal small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate context; flow cytometry and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform, convoluted nuclei and lack strong CD7, whereas T-PLL cells have round to indented nuclei with a nucleolus and are TCL1-positive.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, rather than a monotonous basophilic population.
Leukemic MCL cells can have indented nuclei but are CD5+ B cells with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
ATLL cells show polylobated flower-like nuclei and are CD25+ with HTLV-1 infection.
